spacing_and_layout.container: max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-24 lg:py-32
spacing_and_layout.grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6 lg:gap-8

section_header.title_classes: text-4xl md:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight text-white mb-6
section_header.subtitle_classes: text-lg md:text-xl text-white/60 max-w-2xl mx-auto mb-16
section_header.glow_effect: absolute top-0 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 w-3/4 h-32 bg-purple-500/20 blur-[120px] rounded-full pointer-events-none

video_card.base_classes: relative group bg-white/[0.02] border border-white/[0.08] backdrop-blur-xl rounded-3xl p-2 transition-all duration-500 hover:-translate-y-2 hover:border-purple-500/40 cursor-pointer overflow-hidden flex flex-col h-full
video_card.image_container: relative w-full aspect-[4/5] sm:aspect-video lg:aspect-[4/5] rounded-2xl overflow-hidden mb-4
video_card.image_overlay: absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-[#0B0B0F] via-black/20 to-transparent opacity-80 group-hover:opacity-60 transition-opacity duration-500
video_card.play_button: absolute top-1/2 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-16 h-16 rounded-full bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/20 flex items-center justify-center text-white opacity-0 scale-75 group-hover:opacity-100 group-hover:scale-100 transition-all duration-500 z-10 hover:bg-white/20
video_card.content_container: absolute bottom-0 left-0 right-0 p-6 z-20 flex flex-col justify-end

tag_pill.classes: inline-flex items-center px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-white/5 border border-white/10 text-[10px] md:text-xs font-medium tracking-widest uppercase text-white/70 backdrop-blur-md mb-3 w-fit transition-colors group-hover:bg-purple-500/10 group-hover:border-purple-500/30 group-hover:text-purple-200

video_modal.overlay: fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-[#0B0B0F]/95 backdrop-blur-2xl flex items-center justify-center p-4 sm:p-6 opacity-0 pointer-events-none transition-opacity duration-300
video_modal.container: relative w-full max-w-5xl aspect-video bg-black rounded-2xl sm:rounded-3xl border border-white/10 overflow-hidden shadow-[0_0_100px_rgba(168,85,247,0.2)] scale-95 transition-transform duration-500
video_modal.close_button: absolute top-4 right-4 z-50 w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/20 flex items-center justify-center text-white hover:bg-white/20 transition-colors

motion_and_interactions.hover: Cards lift (-translate-y-2), borders glow purple, play button scales up and fades in, tags highlight to purple.
motion_and_interactions.modal_entry: Overlay fades in, video container scales up from 0.95 to 1.0 with a smooth spring easing.
motion_and_interactions.general: Use Lucide React for icons (Play, X for close). Add `data-testid` to all interactive elements.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a Next.js (or React) page section mapped to these guidelines.
Ensure all backgrounds use the #0B0B0F dark theme with purple/blue gradients overlaid using `bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-500/20 to-blue-500/20 blur-[100px]` behind the cards.
Map the 6 provided media URLs to the video cards.
Implement the modal to simply show an embedded placeholder video (e.g., YouTube/Vimeo iframe or an HTML5 <video> with a poster) or just an interactive 'Video Playing...' UI state.
Implement glassmorphism rigorously: Use `bg-white/[0.02] backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/[0.08]` for surfaces.
